verdict.rationale: Bento keeps skills and rules in the user's own repo as Markdown and YAML. Its official CLI covers dashboard functionality, including reading runs and pulling analytics, and can emit plain JSON to a file, so some data can be taken out in open formats. There is no documented bulk or complete export of all data, such as the full trace history, and no account-exit or offboarding guidance, so 'export all of my data and leave' is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk trace export, confirmation that all data types (traces, issues, signals, memory) are exportable, offboarding or data-deletion guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Skills and rules live in your repo as Markdown and YAML.
Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI: triage issues, read runs, inspect signals, pull analytics.
Plain JSON to stdout. Pipe into `jq`, `grep`, or a file.
